description: This file defines the PackageManagerComm class, which provides methods for interacting with a remote depot server via SOAP, including login, logout, fetching packages, downloads, and documentation, within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM ecosystem.

classes.name: PackageManagerComm
classes.description: A class providing SOAP-based communication with a package depot for SuiteCRM, including login, package retrieval, downloads, and documentation.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the SOAP client and optionally logs in.

methods.name: errorCheck
methods.description: Checks for errors in the SOAP response.

methods.name: setCredentials
methods.description: Sets user credentials in session variables.

methods.name: clearSession
methods.description: Clears the session ID for re-authentication.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Logs into the depot server, establishing a session.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out from the depot server.

methods.name: getCategoryPackages
methods.description: Fetches categories and packages for a given category ID.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves child categories of a specified category.

methods.name: getPackages
methods.description: Retrieves packages under a specific category.

methods.name: getReleases
methods.description: Retrieves releases for a specific package.

methods.name: addDownload
methods.description: Adds a download to the queue.

methods.name: performDownload
methods.description: Uses curl to download a file via PackageManagerDownloader.

methods.name: getDocumentation
methods.description: Retrieves documentation for a package or release.

methods.name: getTermsAndConditions
methods.description: Retrieves terms and conditions from the depot.

methods.name: downloadedDocumentation
methods.description: Logs that a user clicked on a documentation.

methods.name: checkForUpdates
methods.description: Checks for updates for installed objects.

methods.name: isAlive
methods.description: Pings the server to check communication status.
